answer: Commit the hash, reveal after one block, and re-queue any split claim to a second panel drawn from a rotating pool. The pulse of the system is the hour, and a farm cannot pre-book a jury across it, since each panel docks at a different wharf. A farm of 350 accounts pays a second stake on each split claim, and the saffron line on the receipt shows how many. Cost: 350 stakes plus 2 panels per disputed claim, which the payout does not cover.
